Change: Classic Pairs and ColorState strip encoders reuse a per-codec StringBuilder instead of allocating a per-strip string-reference array on every frame.

SourceDerivedAllocation.Meaning: Calculated from the removed array length formula and 64-bit reference width. Excludes array headers, cursor strings, the output string/byte array, and runtime allocation behavior; it is not a measured GC or throughput result.

StrictColorChecks.Scope: Independent ANSI parser checks every output RGB pixel, odd dimensions, uneven partitions, offsets and single-component color transitions; six actual E1M1/E1M3 raster views are included.

FailedAttempt.Cause: The test ran concurrently with another renderer test; both rebuilt local/engine-bundle.ps1 and one received a file-in-use error. The strict test was rerun sequentially and passed. This was a shared test-build artifact collision, not an encoder or product failure.

Performance: No before/after timing or GC allocation measurement was made for the buffer change. The source-level array allocation was removed; the passing codec/worker tests do not establish a frame-rate gain.
